title: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Volodymyr Mnih, Koray Kavukcuoglu, David Silver, Alex Graves, Ioannis Antonoglou, Daan Wierstra, and Martin Riedmiller submitted Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning on December 19, 2013. The paper presented a convolutional neural network trained with a variant of Q-learning to learn control policies directly from raw pixel input and evaluated the approach on seven Atari 2600 games from the Arcade Learning Environment.
significance: A documented deep-reinforcement-learning research milestone combining convolutional neural networks with a variant of Q-learning for control directly from high-dimensional visual input.
